blocks.text: FURINNO 11048 7 cube open shelf features simplicity and easy blend in with any home decor. It offers multiple colours to create your own storage space and also enhances your home. This Series is made of E1 particle board and manufactured in Malaysia. There is no foul smell, durable and the material is stable. A simple attitude towards lifestyle is reflected directly on the design of FURINNO furniture, creating a trend of simply nature. Care instructions: wipe clean with clean damped cloth. Avoid using harsh chemicals. Pictures are for illustration purpose. All decor items are not included in this offer.

items.label: SLEEK & MODERN DESIGN
items.value: This book shelf features a clean-lined 7-cube layout with a closed back that suits living rooms, bedrooms, home offices, or dorms, making the book shelf both stylish and functional

items.label: 7-CUBE STORAGE
items.value: This bookshelf offers versatile cube compartments to organize books, collectibles, decor, or storage boxes, helping the book shelf keep your space tidy and accessible

items.label: WEIGHT CAPACITY
items.value: Each cube supports up to 20 lbs (9 kg); 140 lbs (63.5 kg) total when evenly distributed, keeping the bookshelf safe and reliable for daily storage

items.label: STURDY BUILT
items.value: Crafted from high-quality, durable composite wood, featured back panel adds extra stability and prevents items from falling behind. Built with FSC-certified wood, it unites sustainable materials and refined craftsmanship to deliver long-term durability and reliable use
